name: Notifications
author: WinDock
description: A bell with the unread notification count (WinDock's notifications provider) that opens the notification centre: Windows' (Win+N, sent with SendInput) or WinDock's own popup. With "Show the unread count" off nothing polls; the fixed badge number is then shown instead.

settings.label: Show the unread count
settings.description: Reads Windows' notifications (WinDock then polls the notification list every few seconds). Off: the fixed number below.

settings.label: Fixed badge (0: none)
settings.description: Shown while the unread count is off.

settings.label: Image instead of the bell
settings.description: A file of the widget (after exporting it) or the full path of any file, whose shell icon is drawn.
